source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: UPI OR "Unified Payments Interface" OR ("QR code" AND payment)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:UPI OR "Unified Payments Interface" OR ("QR code" AND payment),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("UPI" OR "Unified Payments Interface" OR ("QR code" AND "payment"))
